name: Camp Fire MR
summary:
# BRING CALM TO YOUR REALITY
In a world of noise, find your quiet center. Campfire MR is a simple, free Early Access tool that uses the power of Mixed Reality (MR) to bring the warmth and tranquility of a campfire into your personal space.


# YOUR PERSONAL MR SANCTUARY
Campfire MR is not a game  or a complex guided meditation app. It is a focused utility  designed for one purpose: to create a "soothing ambiance"  that enhances your environment.
